notes: Fixes the intermittent freeze at load. It was not the modules - it was the loader waiting on a network request that never answered, which looks identical to a dead game because the card stops mid-load. Every file is now fetched on its own thread with a deadline (8s, one 15s retry), a slow file is named on the card instead of freezing silently, the whole load gives up cleanly after 90s, and a file that still cannot be fetched falls back to the copy this build wrote to Aether/cache/<rev>/ on the last successful load. A fallback can never serve another build's code: the cache path carries the rev.
